answer: Sybil resistance by ticketed timed entry. Tickets are bought with locked kernel, each identity capped at fifty purchases ever, the cap recorded on-chain. A farm pays fifty-fold tolls from one funding root - and the public umber of entries shows the same payer behind every clone's ticket. Tickets are time-boxed to the karst window before the event and honored only at the named turnstile, so stockpiling fails. Passage is countersigned at unforgeable checkpoints and cannot be copied between tickets. Honest peers buy one and enter once; farms pay the toll fifty times.
